name: Nww Manufacturing Co. Ltd.
summary: Nww Manufacturing Co. Ltd. primarily specializes in the creation and distribution of automotive ignition wire sets and related coil components. Their comprehensive product line features essential items such as ignition rubber boots, cables, PBT tubes, terminals, distributor caps, and coil-on-plug boots, among other critical assembly parts for vehicle ignition systems. Beyond these specialized offerings, the company also engages in the manufacturing and sale of complete automobiles and motorcycles, along with their associated components. Furthermore, they are involved in the bulk distribution of automotive and motorcycle equipment and produce electronic components. Established in 1998, the company operates from its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
